cond_0001.intro: The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) is central to conducting and managing clinical trials, tasked with obtaining informed consent, executing study protocols, handling human specimens, and ensuring meticulous documentation and communication. This role demands a blend of precision, organization, and professional integrity, underscored by a deep commitment to providing an exceptional patient experience throughout the research journey. By fostering clear communication, demonstrating empathy, and ensuring participants feel respected and valued, CRCs play a vital role in enhancing participant engagement and adherence to study protocols.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Phlebotomy experience
Familiar with e-source reporting via an electronic platform
A clear understanding of ICH, FDA, and GCP regulations
Impeccable organizational skills and attention to detail
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with the Principal Investigator, research team, Study Sponsor/CROs, potential subjects, and referral sources
An ethical compass that compels the candidate to be honest, detail-oriented, and self-driven
High-level critical thinking skills
Working knowledge of medical terminology and lab collection/processing/storage procedures
Proficiency with computers and Microsoft Office Suite
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree
EKG or other patient labs/processes experience
2+ Years of experience as a Clinical Research Coordinator

By fostering clear communication, demonstrating empathy, and ensuring participants feel respected and valued, CRCs play a vital role in enhancing participant engagement and adherence to study protocols. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp clinical trial processes and the regulatory logic behind them.

A clear understanding of ICH, FDA, and GCP regulations
Impeccable organizational skills and attention to detail
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with the Principal Investigator, research team, Study Sponsor/CROs, potential subjects, and referral sources
An ethical compass that compels the candidate to be honest, detail-oriented, and self-driven
High-level critical thinking skills

Proficiency with computers and Microsoft Office Suite

By fostering clear communication, demonstrating empathy, and ensuring participants feel respected and valued, CRCs play a vital role in enhancing participant engagement and adherence to study protocols. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with clinical trial coordination and patient-facing research work.
cond_0554.requirements:
Bachelor's degree preferred, but not required
Phlebotomy experience is required, EKG or other patient labs/processes preferred
Preferably 2+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Coordinator
Familiar with e-source reporting via an electronic platform
A clear understanding of ICH, FDA, and GCP regulations
Impeccable organizational skills and attention to detail
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with the Principal Investigator, research team, Study Sponsor/CROs, potential subjects, and referral sources
An ethical compass that compels the candidate to be honest, detail-oriented, and self-driven
High-level critical thinking skills
Working knowledge of medical terminology and lab collection/processing/storage procedures
Proficiency with computers and Microsoft Office Suite

cond_0648.intro: The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) works alongside the research team to conduct and manage clinical trials. This includes coordinating informed consent, supporting the execution of study protocols, handling human specimens, and ensuring thorough documentation and communication. The role calls for precision, organization, and professional integrity, with a shared commitment to providing a good patient experience throughout the research process. CRCs help ensure participants feel respected and valued, supporting engagement and adherence to study protocols.
cond_0648.responsibilities:
Coordinate with the research team and Principal Investigator to carry out study protocols
Support the informed consent process with participants
Assist with handling, processing, and storing human specimens
Help maintain accurate and thorough documentation across all study activities
Share updates and communicate clearly with the research team, Study Sponsor/CROs, and referral sources
Work alongside team members to ensure compliance with ICH, FDA, and GCP regulations
Support participant engagement and help ensure adherence to study requirements
Coordinate e-source reporting via electronic platforms
